thesis: The host introduces Marco Papic, a chief strategist at Clocktower Group, who discusses his unique background of growing up in war zones and living across multiple countries, which shaped his interest in geopolitics and macroeconomics. Papic explains his career path from academia to the private sector, where he worked at Stratfor and learned to analyze macroeconomics and finance after the 2007-2009 financial crisis forced him to understand these areas to perform his job as a geopolitical analyst.
